reason: The complete preregistered primary envelope produced no profitable enterprise or adoption. This bounded postprimary extension examines unidentified market friction, recurrence and financing assumptions. It is exploratory, not a replacement confirmation campaign.
preserved_defaults: Construction4h, authoringUSD100, weekly engineering4h and all unlisted assumptions remain unchanged from frozen core. These are unidentified scenario points, not estimates or upper bounds.
intervals: 95% normal-approximation Monte Carlo mean interval using1.96*sampleSD/sqrt(12); conditional simulation variability only.
threshold_scope: For a fixed realized path, maximum one-off capability charge preserving B≥A is pairedBminusA+the one-off capability charge actually incurred. Changing that charge can change adoption timing/choices, so this is not a global nonlinear break-even price or empirical cost bound.
successor: No separately tested second asset; no second capability investment admitted.
selection_rule: Run all206configurations with all12newseeds, retain all histories and failures. No further parameter search is part of this protocol.
